answer: Invested motorcycle instructor licence with motorcycle instructors verification turns identity into something scarce. Because a licence instructors renew after assessed rides, the ledge of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The juniper is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The tide is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
